cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 49% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.36% · WTI +0.29% · Brent -0.39% · NatGas +1.65%. 49% of 67 energy names are green — a mixed, rotational tape. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +7.99%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +7.99%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.97%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +22.11%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +22.11%, BE +13.43%, ENPH +9.02%, SEDG +8.92%, EOSE +8.52%. Laggards: FANG -3.70%, PR -2.28%, MPLX -2.19%, APA -2.15%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ARRY moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ARRY is +22.37% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
